title: Household water use in litres and kilolitres
summary: Log water in litres or kilolitres (1 kL = 1,000 L = 1 m³). Savings estimates need your meter consumption and the ₹/kL you pay. Fixture flow cannot be read from a photograph.
content:
Many Indian bills report kilolitres. EcoPath.AI uses L and kL. Enter the billed quantity as measured when it comes from the meter or bill.

Leaks and running taps waste water; a dripping tap can be checked with a bucket and a clock. Low-flow fixtures help only if they actually reduce litres used. Do not use a European €/m³ tariff.

Hyderabad is supplied by a municipal utility (commonly referred to as HMWSSB in public discussion). EcoPath.AI does not hardcode HMWSSB slab rates. Paste your volumetric charge if you want a rupee estimate.

Heating water for bathing also uses electricity or LPG. Without knowing the fuel and temperature rise, EcoPath.AI will not invent kWh saved.
applicability_conditions: Has piped or tanker water with a known quantity
implementation_steps: Enter billed kL and rupees as a water resource record
Time a bucket test if you want flow in L/min for Compare
Leave heating savings blank unless you know the fuel
limitations: Tanker water and borewells may have no meter
No official HMWSSB tariff is stored
